narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: I was checking the pipeline logs for the nightly batch and noticed the transition from raw ingestion to the validation stage. The hand over is not firing on its own. It sits idle until someone manually sends a request to start the validation job. I saw this happen again this morning. The data arrived at the expected time, but the validation step did not begin until a user triggered it from the interface. The system waits for that specific manual action before it proceeds to the next phase.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes a specific observed behavior of the pipeline requiring manual intervention, which is a statement of current system state rather than a wish, refusal, or trade-off.
